sentences.en: I get up at half past six every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上六点半起床。

sentences.en: The walk takes about fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: （走到学校的）路程大约需要十五分钟。

sentences.article_title: A Trip to the City Park
sentences.en: Last Saturday, the weather was fine, so my family went to the city park.
sentences.zh: 上周六天气很好，所以我们全家去了城市公园。

sentences.article_title: A Trip to the City Park
sentences.en: We were all tired but very happy.
sentences.zh: 我们都很累，但非常开心。

sentences.en: She wears glasses because she reads a lot.
sentences.zh: 她戴眼镜，因为她读了很多书。

sentences.en: Lisa wants to be a doctor in the future because she wants to help sick people.
sentences.zh: 丽莎将来想当一名医生，因为她想帮助生病的人。

sentences.en: First, we made the dough with flour and water.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们用面粉和水做了面团。

sentences.en: When the dumplings were ready, the whole family ate together.
sentences.zh: 饺子煮好后，全家人一起吃。

sentences.en: Her favourite place is the sofa near the window, where she can watch birds outside.
sentences.zh: 她最喜欢待的地方是窗边的沙发，在那里她能看到外面的鸟。

sentences.en: I was angry, but when she looked at me with her big eyes, I could not stay angry.
sentences.zh: 我很生气，可当她用大眼睛看着我时，我就气不起来了。

sentences.en: It was Sunday, but it rained heavily all day.
sentences.zh: 那天是星期天，但雨下了一整天。

sentences.en: It was not as beautiful as the cakes in the shop, but it tasted delicious.
sentences.zh: 它不如店里的蛋糕漂亮，但味道很好。

sentences.en: There are more than twenty thousand books in it, and new books arrive every month.
sentences.zh: 图书馆里有两万多本书，而且每个月都有新书到来。

sentences.en: Students can borrow three books each time and keep them for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 学生每次可以借三本书，借期为两周。

sentences.en: Winter was coming, so Mum took me to the shopping centre to buy a new jacket.
sentences.zh: 冬天要来了，所以妈妈带我去购物中心买一件新夹克。

sentences.en: It fitted me well and cost only two hundred and sixty yuan.
sentences.zh: 它很合我身，只花了二百六十元。

sentences.en: The weather in autumn is neither too hot nor too cold.
sentences.zh: 秋天的天气既不太热也不太冷。

sentences.en: The leaves turn yellow, orange and red, and they fall from the trees like butterflies.
sentences.zh: 树叶变成黄色、橙色和红色，像蝴蝶一样从树上飘落。

sentences.en: Grandpa lives in a small village far from the city, so I cannot see him often.
sentences.zh: 爷爷住在离城市很远的小村庄里，所以我不能经常见到他。

sentences.en: After the call, I felt warm.
sentences.zh: 挂了电话后，我心里暖暖的。

sentences.en: Most adults need seven to nine hours of sleep every night, yet millions of people sleep far less than that.
sentences.zh: 大多数成年人每晚需要七到九小时睡眠，然而数百万人睡得远远不够。

sentences.en: Sleep is not a luxury.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不是一种奢侈。

sentences.en: They are free, endless and carefully recommended by algorithms that learn what each user likes.
sentences.zh: 它们免费、无休无止，并由学习每个用户喜好的算法精心推荐。

sentences.en: For users, the advice is simple: enjoy the videos, but decide in advance when to stop.
sentences.zh: 对用户来说，建议很简单：享受视频，但要提前决定何时停止。

sentences.en: There is no long commute, so people save hours every week and spend less on transport.
sentences.zh: 没有漫长的通勤，人们每周省下数小时，交通支出也更少。

sentences.en: The office is not dead, but its job has changed.
sentences.zh: 办公室并没有消亡，但它的职能已经改变。

sentences.en: Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic end up in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 每年都有数百万吨塑料最终进入海洋。

sentences.en: But individuals matter too.
sentences.zh: 但个人的力量同样重要。

sentences.en: Legend says a goat keeper noticed his goats becoming lively after eating red berries from a certain tree, and he tried them himself.
sentences.zh: 传说一位牧羊人注意到山羊吃了某种树上的红浆果后变得活跃，于是自己也尝了尝。

sentences.en: Today, billions of cups are drunk daily, and coffee supports the jobs of about 125 million people worldwide.
sentences.zh: 如今全世界每天要喝掉数十亿杯咖啡，咖啡支撑着全球约一亿两千五百万人就业。

sentences.en: Apps make travel easier, but they cannot replace what happens in your brain when you learn a language yourself.
sentences.zh: 翻译软件让旅行更容易，但无法替代你自己学语言时大脑里发生的变化。

sentences.en: Ten focused minutes a day works better than three hours once a week.
sentences.zh: 每天专注十分钟，胜过每周一次三小时。

sentences.en: For commuters, shared bikes solved the last-mile problem, the gap between a bus or subway station and the final destination.
sentences.zh: 对通勤者来说，共享单车解决了最后一公里问题，即公交或地铁站与目的地之间的空档。

sentences.en: A good idea succeeds only when business innovation and city management grow together.
sentences.zh: 只有商业创新与城市管理共同成长，好主意才能成功。

sentences.en: As heat waves become more frequent, cities are looking for relief, and one of the cheapest tools is simply more green.
sentences.zh: 随着热浪越来越频繁，城市正在寻找缓解之道，而最便宜的办法之一就是多种绿色植物。

sentences.en: Poorer districts often have the fewest trees and suffer the most from heat.
sentences.zh: 较贫穷的街区往往树木最少，受高温之苦也最深。

sentences.en: Today, a large share of retail happens on phones, and the change has reshaped not only how we buy but also what we expect.
sentences.zh: 如今很大一部分零售发生在手机上，这一改变不仅重塑了我们的购买方式，也重塑了我们的期待。

sentences.en: The future of retail is neither pure online nor pure offline, but a blend, with the customer moving smoothly between screens and shelves.
sentences.zh: 零售的未来既不是纯线上也不是纯线下，而是两者的融合，顾客在屏幕与货架之间自如切换。

sentences.en: The story began in 1958, in post-war Japan, where Momofuku Ando wanted to create a cheap, filling meal that people could prepare at home.
sentences.zh: 这个故事始于1958年的战后日本，当时安藤百福想做出一种人们在家就能准备的便宜又顶饱的食品。

sentences.en: Instant noodles may never be health food, but as a symbol of affordable convenience, they have earned their place in food history.
sentences.zh: 方便面也许永远算不上健康食品，但作为平价便利的象征，它已在食品史上赢得了一席之地。

sentences.article_title: AI in Medicine: Promise and Caution
sentences.en: For rural hospitals with few doctors, AI triage tools may mean the difference between an early diagnosis and a late one.
sentences.zh: 对医生稀缺的乡村医院来说，AI 分诊工具可能意味着早期诊断与延误诊断之间的差别。

sentences.article_title: AI in Medicine: Promise and Caution
sentences.en: AI should augment human judgement, never quietly overrule it.
sentences.zh: AI 应当增强人类的判断，而绝不能悄悄地凌驾其上。

sentences.en: Conventional wisdom holds that more options make us better off.
sentences.zh: 传统观念认为，选择越多我们过得越好。

sentences.en: In a world of endless catalogues, knowing when to stop choosing is itself a skill.
sentences.zh: 在商品目录无穷无尽的世界里，知道何时停止选择本身就是一种能力。

sentences.en: Because human attention is finite while content is infinite, platforms compete to capture and hold our focus for as long as possible, and the most sophisticated engineering of our era is deployed towards that single goal.
sentences.zh: 由于人的注意力有限而内容无限，各平台竞相尽可能长久地抢占并留住我们的注意力，这个时代最精密的工程也正服务于这一个目标。

sentences.en: Attention, as Simon foresaw, is the scarce resource of the information age.
sentences.zh: 正如西蒙所预见的那样，注意力是信息时代的稀缺资源。

sentences.en: The deep sea, the zone below two hundred metres where sunlight cannot reach, is the largest habitat on the planet and among the least explored.
sentences.zh: 深海，即阳光无法到达的两百米以下区域，是地球上最大的栖息地，也是被探索得最少的区域之一。

sentences.en: Every expedition returns with species unknown to science: translucent fish, gutless worms sustained by chemical energy, corals older than the pyramids.
sentences.zh: 每次考察都会带回科学界未知的物种：半透明的鱼、靠化学能量存活的无肠蠕虫，以及比金字塔还古老的珊瑚。

sentences.article_title: Misinformation and How to Fight It
sentences.en: False information is not new.
sentences.zh: 虚假信息并不新鲜。

sentences.article_title: Misinformation and How to Fight It
sentences.en: What is new is the velocity and scale that social media grants them.
sentences.zh: 新鲜的是社交媒体赋予它们的传播速度和规模。

sentences.en: In medicine, the prospects are extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 在医学领域，前景是非凡的。

sentences.en: Until then, restraint is not an obstacle to progress; it is a component of it.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，克制不是进步的障碍，而是进步的组成部分。

sentences.en: The arithmetic of global reforestation is brutal.
sentences.zh: 全球再造林这笔账是残酷的。

sentences.en: Seeds, after all, lack the developed root systems of nursery saplings.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，种子缺少苗圃幼苗那样发达的根系。

sentences.en: The engineering achievements are real and impressive: reusable boosters that land themselves have genuinely cut launch costs.
sentences.zh: 这些工程成就确实令人瞩目：能自行着陆的可回收助推器切实降低了发射成本。

sentences.en: That is currently true, but analysts note it is the trajectory that matters; some firms envision thousands of launches a year.
sentences.zh: 这目前是事实，但分析人士指出，重要的是趋势：一些公司设想的是每年数千次发射。

sentences.en: Repair, once a normal act of ownership, has been engineered into a service you must buy.
sentences.zh: 修理，曾经是所有权的一种正常行为，如今却被设计成一项你必须购买的服务。

sentences.en: A repairable product is also, often, a better product: modular design invites upgrades rather than obsolescence.
sentences.zh: 可维修的产品往往也是更好的产品：模块化设计带来的是升级，而不是淘汰。

sentences.en: Community gardens deliver cheap nutrition along with social cohesion and, researchers find, measurable mental health benefits.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，社区花园在提供廉价营养的同时，还带来了社会凝聚力和可测量的心理健康益处。

sentences.en: The technology is advancing quickly.
sentences.zh: 这项技术进步很快。

sentences.article_title: The Productivity Paradox of Remote Work
sentences.en: For tasks that can be measured cleanly—software commits, call-centre resolutions, written reports—remote teams often match or exceed office performance.
sentences.zh: 对于可以清晰衡量的任务——软件提交、客服工单处理、书面报告——远程团队往往能达到甚至超过办公室绩效。

sentences.article_title: The Productivity Paradox of Remote Work
sentences.en: The deepest lesson of remote work is not that offices are obsolete, but that productivity was never a single number.
sentences.zh: 远程工作最深刻的教训并不是办公室已经过时，而是生产力从来不是单一的数字。

sentences.article_title: Open Science and the Cost of Paywalls
sentences.en: findings that cannot be read cannot be built upon
sentences.zh: 无法被阅读的研究成果，也就无法被继续推进。

sentences.article_title: Open Science and the Cost of Paywalls
sentences.en: Reform, in other words, is not merely technical.
sentences.zh: 换言之，改革并不仅仅是技术问题。

sentences.article_title: Cities, Heat, and the Politics of Shade
sentences.en: Heat, in this sense, is not only a climate problem but a map of past decisions.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，高温不仅是气候问题，更是过往决策的地图。

sentences.article_title: Cities, Heat, and the Politics of Shade
sentences.en: Shade, then, is a public resource, and its distribution is a matter of justice as much as engineering.
sentences.zh: 因此，树荫是一种公共资源，其分配既是工程问题，也是正义问题。

sentences.article_title: What Algorithms Cannot See in Hiring
sentences.en: Bias is not a bug that appears; it is a pattern that is reproduced.
sentences.zh: 偏见并非突然出现的故障，而是被不断复现的模式。

sentences.article_title: What Algorithms Cannot See in Hiring
sentences.en: Improving hiring therefore starts with defining competence carefully, measuring it honestly, and auditing outcomes over time.
sentences.zh: 因此，改进招聘首先要认真界定胜任力，诚实测量，并持续审计结果。

sentences.article_title: The Quiet Return of the Night Train
sentences.en: Technologies rarely disappear because a newer mode appears; they survive where they fit a purpose the newcomer does not serve well.
sentences.zh: 技术很少因为更新的形态出现就消失；它们会在自身仍契合、而新事物服务不好的场景中延续。

sentences.en: Resistance is not a distant catastrophe; it is already shortening the useful life of drugs discovered decades ago.
sentences.zh: 耐药性并非遥远的灾难；它已经在缩短几十年前发现的药物的可用寿命。

sentences.article_title: Memory, Forgetting, and the Learning Brain
sentences.en: The goal is not to make study unpleasant, but to align practice with how memory actually works.
sentences.zh: 目的不是让学习变得难受，而是让练习与记忆的真实运作方式一致。

sentences.en: Treating housing as infrastructure means planning for capacity, location, and running costs—decades ahead of the next crisis, not only in response to it.
sentences.zh: 把住房当作基础设施，意味着要提前数十年规划容量、区位与使用成本，而不只是在危机来临时被动应对。

sentences.article_title: The Limits of Personal Carbon Footprints
sentences.en: Climate outcomes will be decided less by the sum of private virtue than by the institutions that structure everyday life.
sentences.zh: 气候结果将更少取决于个人美德的总和，而更多取决于塑造日常生活的制度。

sentences.en: Technology that removes drudgery is welcome; technology that pretends nuance is optional is not.
sentences.zh: 能消除苦役的技术值得欢迎；假装细微差别可有可无的技术则不然。
